rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound describing cakraṃ
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, indicating presence of a pericarp

items.question: What are the defining form and status of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as the king.
The sixth cakra has eight petals.
The sixth cakra possesses a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal center characterized by eight petals and a pericarp.
uncertainties: The precise symbolic significance of the epithet rājānam is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: But the sixth cakra is the king, having eight petals and a pericarp.
